resources.string: Sonder helps you pause before YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or other apps you choose. When enabled, the service detects when a configured target app comes to the foreground and may show a blocking overlay that links to a short challenge in Sonder. Sonder does not read passwords, messages, or page content, does not perform clicks on your behalf, and does not transmit accessibility data off-device. You can disable this service at any time in Settings → Accessibility. Shorts/Reels in-app surface detection is best-effort and may be inaccurate across app versions, languages, or OEMs; package-level blocking for custom apps is reliable.
A focus pause is active for this app. Play one blackjack hand to continue, or take a break.
